54852.summary: The class explores the nature of the New Testament Ecclesia, emphasizing that it consists of believers unified by faith and committed to the kingdom of God. It distinguishes the Ecclesia from the kingdom of God, highlighting the role of faith in Christ as the foundation of the Ecclesia.

54853.summary: The class discusses the concept of discipline within the New Testament Ecclesia, emphasizing its role in preserving purity and fostering spiritual growth. It explores passages from Matthew, Corinthians, and Revelation, highlighting the importance of self-examination and communal responsibility in maintaining ecclesiastical standards.

54854.summary: The class explores the concept of fellowship and friendship in the context of John 15:15, emphasizing the deep relationship between Jesus and his disciples. It draws parallels with Abraham's relationship with God, highlighting the importance of mutual trust and shared purpose in walking with God.
